title: Unit 1–3 總複習
subtitle: 每個單字 2 題：課本例句挖空＋進階題

questions.q: Greg walked up to the manager and shook his ____.
questions.zh: 葛瑞格走向經理並和他握手。
questions.explain: hand：n. 手 & vt. 遞給

questions.q: The price of this car is too ____ for me.
questions.explain: 說價格高要用 high（price is high），不用 tall、big 或 long。

questions.q: Alice loves to play with her ____.
questions.zh: 艾莉絲喜歡玩她的玩偶。
questions.explain: doll：n. 玩偶，洋娃娃

questions.q: 下列哪一句的 big 是「年長的」意思？
choices: My big sister is in college now.
Today is a big day for me.
questions.explain: big sister / big brother＝姊姊／哥哥，big 在這裡是「年長的」。a big day 的 big 是「重要的」。

questions.q: Look! There are many stars ____ the sky.
questions.explain: in the sky＝在天空中，介系詞用 in。

questions.q: The rain has had a very ____ effect on the crops.
questions.zh: 那場雨對農作物造成了不好的影響。
questions.explain: bad：a. 壞的，不好的；很差的；餿掉的

questions.q: This wooden ____ is quite beautiful.
questions.zh: 這張木桌相當漂亮。
questions.explain: desk：n. 桌子(尤指附抽屜的書桌、辦公桌等)

questions.q: It's late. It's time to go to ____.
questions.explain: go to bed＝上床睡覺，bed 前面不加冠詞。

questions.q: This bed is too ____. I like a soft one.
questions.zh: 這張床太硬了。我喜歡軟床。
questions.explain: hard：a. 硬的；難的 & adv. 努力地；猛烈地

questions.q: Taipei is a good city, but it gets a lot of ____.
questions.zh: 臺北是個好城市，但很常下雨。
questions.explain: rain：n. 雨；雨季 & vi. 下雨

questions.q: There are many different ____, such as the twist.
questions.zh: 有許多不同種類的舞蹈，例如扭扭舞。
questions.explain: dance：n. 舞蹈；跳舞；舞會 & vi. & vt. 跳舞

questions.q: How many legs does an insect have?
questions.explain: 昆蟲（insect）有六隻腳；蜘蛛有八隻腳，所以不是昆蟲。

questions.q: Yesterday, it was hot ____ to fry an egg on the street.
questions.zh: 昨天的天氣夠熱到能在街上煎蛋了。
questions.explain: enough：adv. 足夠地；很 & a. 足夠的 & pron. 足夠

questions.q: In fact, ____ are very clever and like to be clean.
questions.zh: 事實上，豬很聰明，也愛乾淨。
questions.explain: pig：n. 豬

questions.q: 下列哪一句的 story 是「(建築物的)層」的意思？
choices: Grandma told us a funny story.
This movie is based on a true story.
I read an interesting story in the newspaper.
questions.explain: story 也可指建築物的樓層，複數為 stories。

questions.q: Monica read the newspaper while drinking a cup of ____.
questions.zh: 莫妮卡邊讀報紙邊喝一杯茶。
questions.explain: tea：n. 茶(飲)；茶葉

questions.q: Mary is an ____ child. She has no brothers or sisters.
questions.explain: only 當形容詞＝唯一的，an only child＝獨生子女。

questions.q: After living abroad for ten years, Amy ____ for home.
questions.explain: long 當動詞＝渴望，long for…＝渴望……。Amy longs for home＝艾咪很想家。

questions.q: I want ____ a new bike.
questions.explain: want + to V＝想要做某事。

questions.q: Josephine brought a shopping ____ with her to the supermarket.
questions.zh: 喬瑟芬帶了一個購物袋去超市。
questions.explain: bag：n. 袋子，提袋

questions.q: It's getting ____. Let's go home.
questions.explain: get + 形容詞＝變得……；It's getting dark＝天快黑了。

questions.q: Our ____ lays an egg almost every day.
questions.explain: hen＝母雞，會下蛋（lay eggs）。

questions.q: My ____ is in a meeting right now. Could you leave a message?
questions.zh: 我老闆正在開會。您可以留言嗎？
questions.explain: boss：n. 老闆，上司 & vt. 使喚，發號施令

questions.q: 下列哪一個字的意思和 cute 最接近？
questions.explain: cute＝可愛的，lovely 也是「可愛的、討人喜歡的」；ugly 是「醜的」。

questions.q: Don't worry about the test. It's a piece of ____!
questions.explain: a piece of cake＝小事一樁、很簡單。

questions.q: Jason ____ a coffee table out of wood.
questions.zh: 傑森用木頭做了一張咖啡桌。
questions.explain: make：vt. 做，製作；使得；趕到，到達

questions.q: Claire always wears a ____.
questions.zh: 克萊兒總是面帶微笑。
questions.explain: smile：n. & vi. 微笑

questions.q: Our neighbor Mr. Wang lives next ____.
questions.explain: live next door＝住在隔壁。

questions.q: It's a ____ day. Don't forget your umbrella.
questions.explain: 修飾名詞 day 要用形容詞 rainy（下雨的）。

questions.q: ____ were swimming peacefully in the pond.
questions.zh: 鴨子在池塘裡悠閒地划著水。
questions.explain: duck：n. 鴨子 & vt. & vi. (突然)低頭/彎腰

questions.q: Adam sat by the ____ to watch the sunset.
questions.zh: 亞當坐在海邊觀賞日落。
questions.explain: sea：n. 海

questions.q: There is a cut on my ____.
questions.zh: 我的手臂上有一道傷口。
questions.explain: arm：n. 手臂 & vt. 使武裝

questions.q: Don't call Julia now. She has already ____ to bed.
questions.explain: has already + 過去分詞（現在完成式）；go 的三態是 go – went – gone。

questions.q: A ____ is a large plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves.
questions.explain: 有樹幹（trunk）、樹枝（branches）、樹葉（leaves）的大型植物是 tree。

questions.q: From ____ on, I will get up early every day.
questions.explain: from now on＝從現在起；from then on 是「從那時起」，用在過去的事。

questions.q: Please fasten your seat ____ before the car starts.
questions.explain: seat belt＝安全帶。

questions.q: Tom ate like a ____ at the party and finished three plates of food.
questions.explain: eat like a pig＝吃得很多、狼吞虎嚥。

questions.q: It's important that you eat ____ and vegetables every day.
questions.zh: 每天吃蔬果是很重要的。
questions.explain: fruit：n. 水果

questions.q: Would you like a ____ of coffee?
questions.explain: a cup of coffee／tea＝一杯咖啡／茶；piece、slice、loaf 用於麵包、蛋糕等。

questions.q: This TV series is based on a true ____.
questions.zh: 這部電視影集是根據一則真實故事。
questions.explain: story：n. 故事；新聞報導；(建築物的)層

questions.q: New York City has many ____ buildings.
questions.zh: 紐約市有很多高樓。
questions.explain: high：a. 高的 & adv.(很)高地 & n. 高峰

questions.q: Everyone agrees that Liam is a nice ____.
questions.zh: 大家都同意連恩是個好男人。
questions.explain: man：n.(成年)男子；人；人類 & vt. 看管，操作

questions.q: It's raining cats and ____. Take an umbrella!
questions.explain: rain cats and dogs＝下傾盆大雨。

questions.q: Vicky loves ____ in the rain.
questions.explain: love + V-ing（或 to V）＝喜愛做某事。

questions.q: There were many large oak ____ in Mason's backyard.
questions.zh: 梅森家的後院有很多大橡樹。
questions.explain: tree：n. 樹(木)

questions.q: Gavin ____ to talk to me.
questions.zh: 蓋文停下來跟我說話。
questions.explain: stop：vt. & vi. & n. 停止 & vt. 阻止 & vi.(短暫)逗留 & n. 站牌

questions.q: The sun shone brightly in the ____ on the hot summer's day.
questions.zh: 太陽在炎熱的夏天高掛空中閃耀。
questions.explain: sky：n. 天空

questions.q: Oscar waited for the ____ to pass by before crossing the street.
questions.zh: 奧斯卡等車子都開過了才穿過街道。
questions.explain: car：n. 汽車

questions.q: I didn't take the bus today. I came to school on ____.
questions.explain: on foot＝步行，固定用單數 foot。

questions.q: I don't know the ____ for my girlfriend's anger.
questions.zh: 我不知道我女友生氣的原因。
questions.explain: reason：n. 原因，理由 & vt. & vi. 推論，推理

questions.q: The cat is ____ itself by the window.
questions.explain: sun 當動詞＝晒太陽；be 動詞 + V-ing 是進行式，sun → sunning 要重複 n。

questions.q: These pants are too big. I need to wear a ____.
questions.zh: 這條褲子太大了。我得繫皮帶。
questions.explain: belt：n. 腰帶，皮帶

questions.q: 下列哪一句的 pen 是動詞「寫」的意思？
choices: The writer penned a letter to his fans.
questions.explain: pen 當動詞＝寫；penned 是過去式。

questions.q: Josh saw a ____ movie yesterday.
questions.zh: 喬許昨天看了一部很長的電影。
questions.explain: long：a. 長的 & adv. 長地；整個地 & vi. 渴望

questions.q: The bank doesn't ____ on Sundays.
questions.explain: doesn't 後面接原形動詞；open 在這裡是「營業」。

questions.q: My cold is getting ____ and ____.
questions.explain: bad 的比較級是 worse、最高級是 worst；比較級 and 比較級＝越來越……。

questions.q: I bought a new pair of ____ yesterday.
questions.explain: a pair of + 複數名詞：a pair of shoes＝一雙鞋。

questions.q: Stop ____ me around! You're not my boss.
questions.explain: boss sb around＝對某人發號施令；stop + V-ing＝停止做某事。

questions.q: Karen thought the ____ was rude for yelling at her.
questions.zh: 凱倫覺得那位男孩對她大吼很無禮。
questions.explain: boy：n. 男孩；兒子

questions.q: Tom ate a whole ____ of potato chips while watching the game.
questions.explain: a bag of potato chips＝一包洋芋片，bag 可當量詞「一袋、一包」。

questions.q: These goods were sent to Japan by ____.
questions.explain: by sea＝經由海運，固定不加冠詞。

questions.q: Tony bought a big chocolate birthday ____ for his girlfriend.
questions.zh: 東尼買了一個巧克力口味的大生日蛋糕給他女友。
questions.explain: cake：n.(一整個)蛋糕

questions.q: I hate to eat ____.
questions.zh: 我討厭吃豆子。
questions.explain: bean：n. 豆子

questions.q: Glenda saw a ____ dress and bought it.
questions.zh: 葛蘭達看到一件可愛的洋裝並買了下來。
questions.explain: cute：a. 可愛的

questions.q: When Bill is not working, he likes to wear running ____.
questions.zh: 比爾沒上班時喜歡穿跑步鞋。
questions.explain: shoe：n.(一隻)鞋子

questions.q: After school, the students ____ for the park.
questions.explain: head 當動詞＝前往，head for…＝前往……。

questions.q: Ian got scared when he saw some ____ flying near his head.
questions.zh: 伊恩看到有些蜜蜂在他頭附近飛時嚇壞了。
questions.explain: bee：n. 蜜蜂

questions.q: Gordon finds it difficult to ____ how he feels.
questions.zh: 高登覺得很難把他的感受說出來。
questions.explain: say：vt. 說，講；(肯定地)表明/表達

questions.q: Could you ____ me the salt, please?
questions.explain: hand 當動詞＝遞給。hand sb sth＝把某物遞給某人。

questions.q: I'd like to add some ____ to my coffee.
questions.zh: 我想在咖啡裡加點牛奶。
questions.explain: milk：n. 牛奶(不可數) & vt. 擠奶

questions.q: Spiders feed on small ____.
questions.zh: 蜘蛛捕食小昆蟲維生。
questions.explain: insect：n. 昆蟲

questions.q: Vicky's ____ for her husband grew over the years.
questions.zh: 多年來，薇琪對老公的愛越來越深。
questions.explain: love：n. & vt. & vi. 愛，喜愛

questions.q: ____ 10 people came to the party, but 50 were invited.
questions.zh: 來參加派對的人只有 10 個，但邀請了 50 個人。
questions.explain: only：adv. 只，僅 & a. 唯一的 & conj. 可是，但是

questions.q: 下列哪一句的 book 是「預訂」的意思？
choices: I'd like to book a table for two tonight.
Tom left his book on the bus.
She reads a book every week.
questions.explain: book 當動詞＝預訂。book a table＝訂位。

questions.q: The baby smiled ____ me.
questions.explain: smile at sb＝對某人微笑。

questions.q: A herd of ____ is eating grass over there.
questions.zh: 那裡有一群牛正在吃草。
questions.explain: cow：n. 乳牛

questions.q: Do you have a runny ____?
questions.zh: 你流鼻水了嗎？
questions.explain: nose：n. 鼻子

questions.q: Ron forgot to close the ____ when he came into the house.
questions.zh: 榮恩進到家裡後忘了關門。
questions.explain: door：n. 門；門口

questions.q: After her husband left, Addison raised her three ____ alone.
questions.zh: 自從她先生離開後，艾蒂森獨自撫養 3 個孩子。
questions.explain: kid：n. 小孩(口語) & vt. & vi. 開玩笑

questions.q: Let's go to the ____ this Saturday.
questions.explain: go to the movies＝去看電影；the movies 指電影院，恆用複數（美式）。

questions.q: Because of email, fewer and fewer people write ____ these days.
questions.zh: 由於有電子郵件，現在越來越少人寫信了。
questions.explain: letter：n. 信；字母

questions.q: My little brother is six ____.
questions.explain: 數字 + years old＝……歲；一歲以上 year 用複數，old 不加 s。

questions.q: The ____ is surrounded by many chicks.
questions.zh: 這隻母雞被許多隻小雞圍繞。
questions.explain: hen：n. 母雞

questions.q: George is busy ____ for the test.
questions.explain: be busy + V-ing＝忙著做某事。

questions.q: Andy is crazy ____ baseball. He watches every game.
questions.explain: be crazy about…＝對……著迷。

questions.q: Exercise is good for our ____.
questions.explain: 子音 + y 結尾的名詞，複數去 y 加 ies：body → bodies。

questions.q: Linda enjoys ____ to pop music.
questions.explain: enjoy 後面接動名詞（V-ing）。

questions.q: Please get ____ the car. We're leaving now.
questions.explain: 上汽車（小型車）用 get in the car；get on 用於公車、火車等大型交通工具。

questions.q: Jason studies very ____, so he always gets good grades.
questions.explain: hard 當副詞＝努力地；hardly 是「幾乎不」，意思完全不同。

questions.q: Trevor nodded his ____ while Bart talked to him.
questions.zh: 崔佛在巴特和他說話時點頭。
questions.explain: head：n. 頭；頭腦；領導人 & vi. 前往 & vt. 率領，主管

questions.q: 下列哪一句是正確的？
choices: Ken is old enough to drive.
Ken is enough old to drive.
Ken is old to enough drive.
Ken enough is old to drive.
questions.explain: enough 修飾形容詞時放在形容詞後面：形容詞 + enough + to V。

questions.q: Harry's shoes are too small for his ____, so they are uncomfortable.
questions.zh: 哈利的鞋子對他的腳來說太小了，所以穿起來很不舒服。
questions.explain: foot：n.(一隻)腳；英尺 & vt. 支付(帳單、費用等)

questions.q: John's room is not as ____ as his older brother's.
questions.zh: 約翰的房間不如他哥哥的房間大。
questions.explain: big：a. 大的；年長的；重要的

questions.q: Our school team won the basketball ____ last night.
questions.explain: game 也有「比賽」的意思，win the game＝贏得比賽。

questions.q: Gordon ____ that he was tired.
questions.explain: say + that 子句；tell 後面要先接人（told me that…）；speak、talk 不直接接 that 子句。

questions.q: Don't spill the ____! The party is a surprise.
questions.explain: spill the beans＝洩露祕密。

questions.q: Stewart dropped the ____ on the floor, and it broke.
questions.zh: 史都華把杯子掉在地板上摔破了。
questions.explain: cup：n.(尤指附有手柄，用來喝茶、咖啡的)杯子

questions.q: George is too ____ to talk to anyone now.
questions.zh: 喬治現在很忙，沒有辦法跟其他人講話。
questions.explain: busy：a. 忙碌的

questions.q: 下列哪一句的 man 是「看管，操作」的意思？
choices: Two guards man the front gate every night.
Every man has his own dream.
The old man lives alone in a small house.
That man over there is my uncle.
questions.explain: man 當動詞＝看管、操作（崗位）。Two guards man the front gate＝兩名警衛每晚看守前門。

questions.q: Lori ____ her mother an expensive purse.
questions.zh: 蘿蕊買了一個昂貴的錢包給她媽媽。
questions.explain: buy：vt. & vi. & n. 購買 & vt. 相信

questions.q: The sad movie made Lisa ____.
questions.explain: make + 受詞 + 原形動詞＝使某人做某事。

questions.q: The students will go on a school trip ____ Friday.
questions.zh: 學生下週五會去校外教學。
questions.explain: next：a. 下一個的，緊接著的 & adv. 接下來，然後；下次

questions.q: Ginny couldn't find a ____, so she wrote in pencil.
questions.zh: 金妮找不到筆，所以用鉛筆來寫。
questions.explain: pen：n.(用墨水的)筆 & vt. 寫

questions.q: 下列哪一句的 hot 是「辣的」意思？
choices: This curry is too hot for me. My mouth is on fire!
It's very hot today. Let's go swimming.
The water in the pool is too hot.
questions.explain: hot 也有「辛辣的」意思；嘴巴像著火一樣，指的是咖哩太辣。

questions.q: Sharon is a businesswoman and ____ a mother of three children.
questions.zh: 雪倫是女企業家，也是 3 個小孩的母親。
questions.explain: also：adv. 也，而且

questions.q: Robert found his missing shoe under his ____.
questions.zh: 羅伯特在床底下找到他不見的鞋子。
questions.explain: bed：n. 床

questions.q: I have to hit the ____ tonight, so I can't go to the movies with you.
questions.zh: 我今晚必須用功讀書，因此沒辦法跟你去看電影。
questions.explain: book：n. 書 & vt. & vi. 預訂

questions.q: There isn't ____ milk in the fridge.
questions.explain: milk 是不可數名詞，要用 much 修飾，不能用 many、a 或 few。

questions.q: It was so cloudy that the ____ could not be seen.
questions.zh: 烏雲密布，以致於看不到太陽。
questions.explain: sun：n. 太陽；陽光 & vt. & vi. 晒太陽，做日光浴

questions.q: Wendy's father taught her how to ride a ____.
questions.zh: 溫蒂的爸爸教她如何騎腳踏車。
questions.explain: bicycle：n. 腳踏車，自行車(= bike)

questions.q: Please leave your key at the front ____ when you check out of the hotel.
questions.explain: front desk＝（飯店的）櫃檯。

questions.q: The police officers were ____ with guns.
questions.explain: arm 當動詞＝使武裝，be armed with…＝配備（武器）。

questions.q: Turn that music down! It's driving me ____!
questions.zh: 把音樂關掉！它讓我快抓狂了！
questions.explain: crazy：a. 瘋狂的；荒唐愚蠢的；著迷的

questions.q: Health is ____ than money.
questions.explain: important 是多音節形容詞，比較級用 more important。

questions.q: The weather's been quite ____ recently.
questions.zh: 最近的天氣很熱。
questions.explain: hot：a. 熱的；辛辣的；熱門的；暴躁易怒的

questions.q: Julia ____ down the stairs instead of taking the elevator.
questions.zh: 茱麗亞走下樓梯，而沒有搭電梯。
questions.explain: go：vi. 走；去；從事；離開；變成；進行 & n. 嘗試

questions.q: The doctor told Mr. Lee to stop ____. It's bad for his health.
questions.explain: stop + V-ing＝停止做某事；stop + to V 是「停下來去做某事」，意思不同。

questions.q: The bank is ____ to the post office.
questions.explain: next to…＝在……旁邊；beside、by 後面不加 to，between 要接兩者。

questions.q: The window is wide ____.
questions.zh: 這扇窗戶是敞開著的。
questions.explain: open：a. 打開的；營業的 & vt. & vi. 打開；營業；開始

questions.q: There are over three million people living in the ____.
questions.zh: 有超過 300 萬人住在這座城市。
questions.explain: city：n. 城市

questions.q: Tom said he was sick, but I don't ____ his story. I think he's lying.
questions.explain: buy 口語可當「相信」。I don't buy it＝我才不信。

questions.q: Horror movies are not my cup of ____. I prefer comedies.
questions.explain: not my cup of tea＝不是我喜歡的類型。

questions.q: Mia dressed her ____ in a pink dress and put it to bed.
questions.explain: doll＝玩偶、洋娃娃，可以幫它穿衣服、哄它睡覺。

questions.q: Poker is a card ____ that people around the world play.
questions.zh: 撲克牌是一種全世界的人都會玩的紙牌遊戲。
questions.explain: game：n. 遊戲；比賽；(比賽中的)一局

questions.q: Wendy goes to school ____ bicycle every day.
questions.explain: by + 交通工具（不加冠詞）＝搭乘／騎……：by bicycle、by car。

questions.q: What the teacher has just said is really ____.
questions.zh: 老師剛才所說的話真的很重要。
questions.explain: important：a. 重要的

questions.q: Mom works from morning till night. She's as busy as a ____.
questions.explain: as busy as a bee＝像蜜蜂一樣忙碌。

questions.q: Suzie enjoys playing with her ____ in the park.
questions.zh: 蘇西喜歡和她的狗在公園一起玩。
questions.explain: dog：n. 狗

questions.q: Let's go to a ____ tonight! What would you like to see?
questions.zh: 我們今晚去看電影吧！你想要看什麼呢？
questions.explain: movie：n. 電影，影片；電影院(恆用複數)〔美〕

questions.q: Taipei and Kaohsiung are two big ____ in Taiwan.
questions.explain: 子音 + y 結尾的名詞，複數去 y 加 ies：city → cities。

questions.q: 下列哪一句的 letter 是「字母」的意思？
choices: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.
I got a letter from my pen pal.
Please mail this letter for me.
She wrote a love letter to him.
questions.explain: letter 除了「信」，也指「字母」；英文字母共 26 個。

questions.q: Sharon is a teacher. She is ____ a singer.
questions.explain: also 放在 be 動詞後面；too 放句尾；either 用在否定句。

questions.q: Kevin ____ when the ball flew toward his head.
questions.explain: duck 當動詞＝突然低頭／彎腰（閃躲）。

questions.q: Nancy ____ a lot of great gifts for her birthday.
questions.zh: 南希收到一大堆很棒的生日禮物。
questions.explain: get：vt. 收到，得到；買到；拿來；感染上；使得；理解 & vi. 到達；變得

questions.q: Here's a tissue. You can blow your ____.
questions.explain: blow one's nose＝擤鼻涕。

questions.q: The ____ man can no longer walk very well.
questions.zh: 這名老先生已經無法好好走路了。
questions.explain: old：a. 年老的；……歲的；老舊的；從前的

questions.q: What do you ____ to do tomorrow?
questions.zh: 你明天要做什麼？
questions.explain: want：vt. 想要 & n. 需求(常用複數)；缺乏

questions.q: Harriet wasn't happy with her ____, so she decided to lose weight.
questions.zh: 哈莉特不滿意自己的身體，因此決定減重。
questions.explain: body：n. 身體

questions.q: Tell me the reason ____ you were late.
questions.explain: the reason why + 子句＝……的原因。

questions.q: Mr. and Mrs. Chen have three children: two ____ and a girl.
questions.explain: boy 也有「兒子」的意思；children 是小孩，所以是 two boys（兩個兒子）and a girl。

questions.q: Most of the milk we drink comes from ____.
questions.explain: cow＝乳牛，我們喝的牛奶大多來自乳牛。

questions.q: You won the lottery? You're ____ me!
questions.explain: kid 當動詞＝開玩笑；You're kidding (me)!＝你在開玩笑吧！（進行式，kid → kidding 要重複 d）

questions.q: David ____ works at a big company in the US.
questions.zh: 大衛現在在美國的一間大公司上班。
questions.explain: now：adv. 現在，目前；馬上，立刻 & n. 現在

questions.q: 下列哪一個不是水果？
questions.explain: bean 是豆子，不是水果（fruit）。
